description: boss 来了：一键全屏伪装成蓝屏 / Windows 更新 / gcc 编译现场；退出按键序列与自动消失时间可配置。
author: ra9fael

hint.zh: 逗号分隔的 子词=场景，场景为 bsod/update/gcc；如 b=bsod,u=update,t=gcc
hint.en: Comma-separated token=scene pairs; scenes are bsod/update/gcc, e.g. b=bsod,u=update,t=gcc

hint.zh: 伪装界面下直接键入该序列即退出（不区分大小写）；留空用默认 deadbeef
hint.en: Type this sequence on the cover to exit (case-insensitive); empty uses the default deadbeef

hint.zh: 0 表示一直伪装到手动退出
hint.en: 0 keeps the cover until dismissed manually

hint.zh: 编译输出里显示的目标名
hint.en: The target name shown in the build output

hint.zh: mouse=只盖鼠标所在的屏幕，all=盖住所有显示器
hint.en: mouse=cover only the screen with the mouse, all=cover every display

hint.zh: b 蓝屏 · u 更新 · t 编译；Enter 全屏伪装，键入退出序列返回
hint.en: b bluescreen · u update · t build; Enter covers the screen, type the exit sequence to return
